tha-ap178:1.1: Maggadattika.] *Anomadassī bhagavā dvipa*dindo narāsabho / diṭṭhadhammasukhatthāya ambhokāsamhi caṅkami. // //
tha-ap178:2.1: Uddhate pāde pupphāni lāsaṃ muddhani tiṭṭhare / pasannacitto sumano vanditvā puppham okiriṃ. // //
tha-ap178:3.1: Vīsaṃ kappa*sahassamhi ito pañ*ca janā ahuṃ / Pupphachadaniyā nāma cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap178:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Maggadattiko thero i. g. a-ti.
